scope: Portable initial ClientWorld snapshot and independent remote asset resolution
adaptations: New replacement network protocol version 2. Value records preserve the existing local publisher fields; no original game algorithms or asset bytes are imported.
Explicit little-endian f32/f64/integer encoding; 1 MiB snapshot, 32768-byte reliable packets, exact bounded ordered chunk assembly and atomic receiver replacement.
Independent client model/sprite stores and DAT binding checks; no ObjectDLL construction, model-key callbacks, server registries or GPU objects.
Server captures one recipient-addressed initial frame after fresh admission, including a reconnect into an advanced world. Cross-channel order is not assumed.
Continuous membership/poses, interpolation, collision/environment/audio/effect/HUD delivery and cross-frame retired-identity policy remain subsequent work.
